name: sonic_envelope
protocol_source: g1_wbc_envelope_v2 (experiments/g1_wbc_envelope.py at ddcac4e): Probe, criteria() gate function and wilson() are imported, not copied
controller: SonicBackend/SonicController (dream/robot/sonic.py, b4ccef1), direct start (init_s=0), arms='report'. UNOFFICIAL Python/onnxruntime port of gear_sonic_deploy, not verified against the reference C++ binary.
body: build_mobile_g1(hands=True, head_camera=None), fingers held open (G1MobileEnv default hand targets 0)
gate_notes: Identical to g1_wbc_envelope_v2 gates (values copied from that config). Additions, all stated here before the run: (a) intended knee contact in kneel segments (commanded height < 0.40, i.e. planner kneelTwoLeg, and the 'back' segment that follows a kneel segment) is recorded separately in extras.intended_knee_contact and is NOT undesired ground contact; only the two knee links qualify, any other non-foot body (shin, hand, pelvis, ...) or a knee contact outside a kneel segment still counts as undesired. (b) tilt latch = pelvis tilt > g1_wbc.FALL_TILT (0.6 rad), the WBC latch value, applied by the evaluator (SONIC has no latch of its own; its port stops at 60 deg). (c) height tracking keeps the 0.04 m tolerance against the commanded pelvis height (0.74 -> idle, SONIC standing pelvis is about 0.79 m): if the known SONIC pelvis offset fails it, that is a measured result and is not loosened. (d) rpy tracking uses the WBC definition (waist chain on commanded axes only); static cells command rpy 0 so it is vacuous exactly as in WBC pitch-0 cells; joint_reference cells command the reference's own derived torso rpy. (e) a segment whose execution is refused, times out or is stopped is incomplete and fails height/rpy tracking exactly as an incomplete WBC segment does. (f) support is also evaluated a second way for kneel segments (criteria_kneel_support in the trial files, kneel_support_adjusted in the summary): a leg counts as supported when its foot OR its knee touches the floor and the CoM margin uses foot plus knee contact points. The envelope uses only the strict WBC definition (feet only); the adjusted variant is reported beside it. (g) joint_reference cells add one gate, hand_error: FK hand error of the reaching arm (achieved q and attitude vs reference q and attitude, pelvis-yaw frame, mean of the last second of the hold) <= gates.hand_error_fk_m.

reference_generation.planner: dream.robot.g1_posture.PosturePlanner (import only), obstacle-free, explicit stance = robot start pose, arms: planner chooses the better of left/right
reference_generation.target_xy_note: the first candidate with a feasible plan is used, in the listed order; chosen before any SONIC run

reference_execution.profile: minimum jerk from the planner's nominal standing body q to the reference body q, body joints only; SonicBackend blends from the measured pose to the first frame at 0.5 rad/s first

joint_reference_rule: 'joint_reference' is listed in envelope kinds only if all six references are feasible in the planner, run, and are stable in 5/5 trials under all gates (collapse gates, torque, height tracking 0.04 m against the reference pelvis height, return to nominal, and hand FK error <= 0.05 m). Otherwise it is omitted and the per-reference counts are reported.
height_m_rule: posture is listed only if at least one static cell passes 5/5; height_m = [lowest, highest] commanded height of the longest contiguous run (in the sorted list of static heights) of cells that pass 5/5 (ties: the run containing the highest height); if no static cell passes, height_m = [1.0, 0.0] (empty, nothing executable). Transitions, pushes and the grid's neighbours are reported but do not widen it.
interpolation_rule: Heights between measured cells are executable only inside height_m (every measured cell in the span passes, which includes both neighbours of any in-span request). Everything else is unmeasured and not executable autonomously. Pushes and transitions are reported evidence beside the region, not a widening of it.
notes: Protocol frozen before the run. Development used only the 1-seed smoke test (seed 19, outside the measured seeds 20-24; cells static_h0.30 and ref_h0.65, results in results/sonic_envelope_smoke) and the offline reference generation. Memory: one MuJoCo process at a time, one subprocess per trial.
